# Security Checklist: Cypher Query Access

**Purpose**: Validate that SPEC-013 security requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable before task generation.
**Created**: 2026-07-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist security` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Input Bounds and Diagnostic Safety

- [x] CHK001 Are query length limits defined before lexing across package API, CLI positional input, CLI stdin, and MCP input? [Security, Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK002 Are diagnostic excerpts bounded, escaped, UTF-16-safe, and prohibited for oversized and malformed-stdin inputs? [Security, Clarity, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK003 Are raw query text, string literal values, emitted SQL, bound parameters, and oversized input excluded from logs, telemetry, malfunction messages, and expected error output except for bounded diagnostic excerpts? [Security, Privacy, Spec §FR-023, Contract §Diagnostics]

## Parser and Literal Handling

- [x] CHK004 Are write clauses, direct SQL, external parameters, unsupported openCypher forms, and mutating statements rejected before SQLite prepare/execution? [Security, Completeness, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK005 Are backtick identifiers bounded by exact escaping, control-character rejection, Unicode escape rejection, case-sensitive comparison, and no normalization? [Security, Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK006 Are string literal quote style, escapes, raw control characters, Unicode escape forms, decoded comparison semantics, and SQL parameter binding rules explicitly specified for untrusted query text? [Security, Clarity, Spec §FR-016, Contract §String Literal Rules]

## SQL Emission and Read-Only Execution

- [x] CHK007 Are emitted SQL statements restricted to one parameterized `SELECT`, `WITH`, or `WITH RECURSIVE` statement with every CTE body and final statement `SELECT`-only? [Security, Completeness, Spec §FR-024, Data Model §Planned Query]
- [x] CHK008 Are all query literals required to become bound parameters rather than SQL string concatenation? [Security, Injection, Spec §FR-016, Data Model §Planned Query]
- [x] CHK009 Is execution required to use a dedicated read-only SQLite connection that does not initialize, migrate, heal, journal/WAL-change, index, sync, watch, or reach write helpers? [Security, Least Privilege, Spec §FR-024, Plan §Read-Only SQLite Open Path]

## Timeout, Worker Cleanup, and Dormancy

- [x] CHK010 Is the fixed five-second deadline specified with no partial rows, worker termination/replacement, and no background continuation after timeout? [Security, Resource Control, Spec §FR-021, Spec §FR-022, Plan §Deadline and Worker Lifecycle]
- [x] CHK011 Are dormant/local-only behavior and no-network/no-unexpected-schema-write constraints stated for this capability? [Security, Privacy, Spec §Assumptions, Constitution §VII]
- [x] CHK012 Is external/off-box evaluation blocked until explicit runtime authorization names provider, endpoints, data, retention/training, cost/time, and timestamp? [Security, Privacy, Spec §FR-030]

## MCP and Agent Trust Boundaries

- [x] CHK013 Are expected recoverable MCP diagnostic and timeout states success-shaped while `isError` remains reserved for path/access refusals and malfunctions? [Security, Trust Boundary, Spec §FR-028]
- [x] CHK014 Are MCP steering changes subject to retrieval-guardian review and retrieval A/B validation before merge? [Security, Regression Surface, Spec §FR-030, Constitution §VI]

## Notes

- Initial security run found two gaps: missing cross-surface redaction/logging contract and underspecified untrusted string literal syntax/escaping contract.
- Remediation added explicit string literal rules, parameter-binding requirements, redaction/logging exclusions, and security fixture expectations to the authoritative spec, grammar contract, data model, and plan.
- Re-run result: no gap markers remain in the Security checklist domain.
